name: 24390-longdecode-gptoss120b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2), sm90.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, mxfp4 expert weights (~65 GB of safetensors), 36 attention layers, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads of head_dim 64, 128 experts with 4 active per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 64 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 24390. Roughly 8-10 minutes of traffic.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 5120 prompt tokens and 8192 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, single turn, no shared prefix; `ignore_eos` and a hard `max_tokens` are set, so 8192 output tokens are actually generated.
purpose: A long-form report writer on two GPUs, turning 5k-token briefs into 8k-token drafts for 32 concurrent users.
